<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 5:14">Targ. Ex. V, 14</cite> <he>גְּזֵירַתְכוֹן</he> your decreed task.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 10:25">Targ. I Kings X, 25</cite> <he>גְּזֵירַת וכ׳</he> the decreed (tax) of every year.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 1:8">Targ. O. Ex. I, 8</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Gittin 55b:14">Gitt. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ קמייתא</he> the first (Roman) decree (after the capture of Jerusalem).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 35a:9">Ab. Zar. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>כי גזרי ג׳ וכ׳</he> when they published a (religious) enactment in Palestine.—Pl. <cite ref="C00556"><he>גְּזֵירָתָא</he></cite>.
